# A successful Zellij message cannot replace the stable open-project result.
env ZWM_TEST_ZELLIJ_OUTPUT=misleading-success
exec zwm o project
cmpenv stdout created
! stderr .
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG want-log

-- created --
project_root=$HOME/code/project
tab_action=created
tab_title=project
tab_cwd=$HOME/code/project
-- want-log --
{"sequence":1,"command":"git","args":["rev-parse","--show-toplevel"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
{"sequence":2,"command":"git","args":["worktree","list","--porcelain","-z"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
{"sequence":3,"command":"zellij","args":["action","query-tab-names"],"cwd":"$WORK"}
{"sequence":4,"command":"zellij","args":["action","new-tab","--layout","$HOME/.config/zellij/layouts/worktree.kdl","--name","project","--cwd","$HOME/code/project"],"cwd":"$WORK"}
